detaileddescription.para: Internally, this is stored as log2(align) + 1. We reserve 5 bits to encode this value which allows the following values 0b00000 -> unset 0b00001 -> 1ULL << 0 = 1 0b00010 -> 1ULL << 1 = 2 0b00011 -> 1ULL << 2 = 4 ... 0b11111 -> 1ULL << 30 = 1 GiB
